correctness.rationale: For a>1 and positive periodic crowding, y=1/x obeys a y_(t+1)-y_t=beta_t. Its n-step affine map is a positive-intercept strict contraction, giving unique globally attracting positive period. Exact Fourier division Y_k=B_k/(a exp(2pi i k/n)-1) makes |Y_k|^2 unchanged under reversing real beta, so every lag autocorrelation agrees. For n=3, the three explicit inverse numerators have identical e1,e2 and product difference -a(a-1)^3(a+1)(b-c)(b-d)(c-d). Shifting all numerators by q(a^3-1) preserves the first two symmetric sums and product difference, hence the exact expression in RESULT.md with strictly positive remaining factor. Periods 1 and 2 reverse only by cyclic rotation. The delivered checker verified symbolic identities and 612 exact assertions; these finite tests support rather than replace the proof. No singular denominator occurs for a>1, beta>0, q>=0.

originality.rationale: A structural all-period autocorrelation blind spot and an exact three-season saturated-response ordering are not given by the inspected primary works. The 2012 general mean formula can recover individual ordinary means and thus is not claimed as new; nontrivial contribution is the reverse-comparison theorem, its no-parameter-crossing sign, and the simultaneous inverse-second-order invariance. Full-text access limits to two plausible articles and unknown equivalent signal-processing specializations remain explicit priority risks.
residual_risks: The closed-access Allen–Kocic 2013 complete article was not inspected, though its abstract describes some results for periods greater than two; a hidden equivalent permutation result remains possible.
The full text of the later Al-Ghassani–AlSharawi permutation paper was not available; its abstract concerns a different harvested recursion and a geometric-mean objective.

Published arbitrary-period mean formulas logically subsume numerical q=0 evaluations; the novelty assessment concerns the stronger combined structural theorem rather than numerical or algebraic specialization alone.
A classical signal-processing treatment could already state the Fourier reversal-invariance mechanism; historical novelty of the precise ecological joint statement is provisional.

value.rationale: The result answers a natural identifiability and intervention-ordering question for the canonical periodically forced Beverton–Holt model. It proves that no second-order cyclic statistic of reciprocal biomass can detect reversal, while saturating population measurements discriminate as soon as three distinct seasons occur; the ordering is exact for all positive growth rates, crowding strengths and saturation levels. This is a complete sharp minimal-period classification with a mechanistically motivated nonlinear response, not an arbitrary finite enumeration. Its use is as a mathematical benchmark for annual-condition ordering and inference, not a calibrated ecological prescription.
